body: The function [`getHierarchicalFacetBreadcrumb`](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/94f40da97a0efb4845436f207ddbf5efca223514/src/SearchParameters/index.js#L1467-L1482)  always return an array.

The behavior with the warning is a bit different. Previously we were returning an empty configuration which was merged with the previous one. Now we override the facet definition. I don't think it matters to have one or the other, but the current solution match with the expectation of the function to be driven by the UI state & self-contained.
you mean that you kept it as a comment, because it was good, but right now unused?
Should we track the warning message?
Could this be part of the tests setup?
We have only one possible message at the moment, not sure it is worth it.
Yes we almost always perform the same setup.
I mean resetting the warning cache after each test so that they're independent.
It's kinda what is happening no?
I meant as part of our setup to no have to do it inside our test files.
Yes so globally then. We can do it inside a dedicated PR, at the same time remove the rest of the tests that reset the cache.
